fields.options: HYD Household Profile
fields.label: 1.1 Household ID
fields.description: The household this person lives in (taken from the household list).

fields.label: 1.2 Individual ID
fields.description: The member's ID from the household roster (UIN). Filled in from the roster when the household and name match a roster row.

fields.label: 1.3 Individual Name
fields.description: Enter the individual's name as recorded in the family.

fields.label: 1.4 Date of birth
fields.description: Enter the individual's date of birth. If the exact date is not known, enter the first day of the month or year mentioned.

fields.label: 1.5 Age
fields.description: Calculated automatically from the date of birth (completed years).

fields.label: 1.6. Sex
fields.options:
Male
Female
Others
Prefer not to say
fields.description: Ask the respondent to select the sex category that best describes the individual.

fields.label: 2.1. Education status
fields.options:
Currently studying
Completed Education
Dropped
Never school enrolled
Yet to enrol in school (in case child is below 6 years of age)
fields.description: Record the individual's current education status. Select the option that best describes their schooling or educational situation. Currently studying: ask 2.2 and 2.3. Completed: 2.4. Dropped: 2.4 and 2.5. Never enrolled: 2.5. Yet to enrol: 2.6.

fields.label: 2.2. If currently studying, mention current education
fields.description: Mention current class if studying below class 10 (e.g. grade 3, grade 7) or course and year of education (e.g. 1st year Intermediate, 2nd year UG).

fields.label: 2.3. Where do you study?
fields.options:
Government institution
Private institution
fields.description: Record the type of educational institution they are attending, based on the management of the school, college or institution.

fields.label: 2.4. If completed or dropped out of education, what is the highest level of education completed?
fields.description: Record the highest level or class successfully completed. Write actuals, e.g. grade 5, 10, or intermediate, or UG, or PG, or diploma in computers.

fields.label: 2.5. Reasons for never enrolled or dropped out of education
fields.options:
Not interested
No access to institutions
Due to financial constraints
Schools/colleges did not admit (mention reasons)
Support in household income
Migration
Medium of teaching
Others, specify
fields.description: Select the primary reason why the individual never enrolled in school or discontinued education before completion.

fields.label: 2.6. If child is below 6 years, child is enrolled in the following
fields.options:
Creche
Anganwadi centre
Not enrolled in either creche or Anganwadi centre
fields.description: Captures the child's participation in early childhood care, nutrition and pre-school education services.
fields.depends_on: eval:doc.q2_1_education_status=="Yet to enrol in school (in case child is below 6 years of age)"

fields.label: 2.7. Reasons for not enrolling children in creche
fields.options:
No creche nearby
Expensive to enrol in creche
Don't know if there is creche nearby
Not interested to enrol
Others, specify
fields.description: The main reason why the child is not enrolled in a creche.
fields.depends_on: eval:doc.q2_6_child_below_6_years_child=="Not enrolled in either creche or Anganwadi centre"

fields.label: 2.8. Reasons for not enrolling children in Anganwadi
fields.options:
No Anganwadi centre
Don't know if there is Anganwadi nearby
Anganwadi did not admit - no Aadhar
Anganwadi did not admit - no immunization card
Not interested to enrol
Others, specify
fields.description: The main reason why the child is not enrolled in an Anganwadi centre.
fields.depends_on: eval:doc.q2_6_child_below_6_years_child=="Not enrolled in either creche or Anganwadi centre"

fields.label: 3.1. Where was the child born?
fields.options:
Hospital
Home
fields.description: Questions 3.1 to 3.4 are for children below 6 years. The rest are for everyone. The place where the child was born.

fields.label: 3.2. When was the last height & weight of child checked?
fields.options:
Less than 1 month ago
6 months ago
I don't remember
Never checked
fields.description: How recently the child's growth was monitored through height and weight measurement.

fields.label: 3.3. Has the child received age-appropriate immunization?
fields.options:
Yes
No
I don't know
fields.description: Whether the child has received all vaccinations recommended for their age.

fields.label: 3.4. If no, what are the reasons?
fields.options:
Lack of awareness about immunization
Distance to vaccination centre
Vaccine not available
Other (Specify)
fields.description: The main reason why the child has not received age-appropriate immunization.

fields.label: 3.5. Does the individual have any disability?
fields.options:
Yes
No
fields.description: Whether the individual has any long-term physical, sensory, intellectual, or developmental disability.

fields.label: 3.6. If yes, specify
fields.options:
Blindness
Deafness
Speech disorder
Autism
Mobility-impaired
Other (Specify)
fields.description: The type of disability experienced by the individual.

fields.label: 3.7. Does the individual have a disability certificate?
fields.options:
I have
I have but corrections required
I have but not sure if corrections required
Applied but rejected
Applied but haven't received
I never applied
Don't know where to apply
fields.description: The individual's disability certificate status, and any support required to obtain or update the certificate.

fields.label: 3.9. Does the individual have any diagnosed chronic or long-term illness?
fields.options:
Yes
No
Prefer not to say
fields.description: Whether the individual has been diagnosed by a healthcare professional with any long-term or chronic health condition.

fields.label: 3.10. If yes, what illness or health condition does the individual have?
fields.options:
Diabetes
Hypertension
Heart disease
Kidney disease
Respiratory illness (asthma, TB, etc.)
Cancer
Epilepsy
Neurological condition
Mental health condition
Other (Specify)
fields.description: The diagnosed chronic illness or long-term health condition affecting the individual. More than one can be selected.

fields.label: 3.11. Does the individual require regular medication or ongoing treatment?
fields.options:
Yes
No
fields.description: Whether the individual requires regular medication or ongoing treatment for a health condition.

fields.label: 4.1. Employment status
fields.options:
Employed
Unemployed
Student
Homemaker
Retired
Unable to work due to health
Other (Specify)
fields.description: The individual's current employment or primary activity status. Ask these questions only if the individual is 18 years or above. If unemployed, skip to 4.6.

fields.label: 4.2. If employed, what is the occupation of this person?
fields.options:
Daily-wage worker
Street vendor
Domestic worker
Construction worker
Gig/platform worker (auto, cab, bike, delivery partner & services)
Security guard
Waste picker
Sanitation worker
Tailor
Factory worker
Home-based worker
Housekeeping (hotel/hospital, etc.,)
Salesperson/marketing
Beautician
Hamali
Teacher
IT services
Other (Specify)
fields.description: The individual's primary occupation or type of work.

fields.label: 4.3. Work regularity (mention days worked in a typical month)
fields.description: How many days the individual typically works in a month.

fields.label: 4.4. Monthly income in INR
fields.description: The individual's average monthly income from all sources, in rupees. If the respondent prefers not to disclose their income, tick 'Prefer not to respond' and go to the next question.

fields.label: 4.5. Income stability
fields.options:
Regular
Seasonal
fields.description: Whether the individual's income is received consistently throughout the year or varies by season or availability of work.

fields.label: 4.6. If unemployed, reasons
fields.options:
Disability/illness
Lack skills
Childcare responsibilities
Household responsibilities
Jobs not available nearby
Pregnancy or recent childbirth
Elderly care responsibilities
Safety concerns at the workplace
Low wages / work not financially viable
Seasonal or irregular availability of work
Other (Specify)
fields.description: The main reason why the individual is currently unemployed.

fields.label: 4.7. What are this person's livelihood aspirations?
fields.description: The type of livelihood, employment, or income-generating opportunity the individual would like to pursue in the future.

fields.label: 4.8. Support required to achieve livelihood aspirations?
fields.description: The support, resources, or assistance required by the individual to achieve their livelihood or employment goals.
